title: Interaction is compatible with causal closure if behavior can be overdetermined

statements.text: Interactionism is assumed incompatible with a causally closed physical world, but this does not follow if behavior can be causally overdetermined, with a complete physical cause and a mental cause. Mills defends this, arguing that an effect can have features its sufficient physical cause does not explain.

sources.quote: This is a very natural assumption, but it is not justified if causal overdetermination of behaviour is possible.
